title.zh: 将马尼拉第三区 Raja Soliman 中学改设为名为 Raja Soliman 科学与技术中学的国立科学技术中学并为其拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Raja Soliman High School in the Third District of Manila Into a National Science and Technology High School to Be Known as the Raja Soliman Science and Technology High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Raja Soliman High School in the Third District of Manila Into a National Science and Technology High School to Be Known as the Raja Soliman Science and Technology High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8843_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Raja Soliman High School in the Third District of Manila is hereby converted into a national science and technology high school to be known as the Raja Soliman Science and Technology High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The Raja Soliman Science and Technology High School shall offer secondary, vocational and technological courses and a skills training program.
All personnel, records, assets and liabilities of the Raja Soliman High School are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Raja Soliman Science and Technology High School.

The amount necessary for the initial implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Raja Soliman High School. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the continuous operation and maintenance of the Raja Soliman Science and Technology High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
